summary_en: The company decided to cancel 2,000,000 treasury shares on November 20, 2026, representing 2.69% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation will be effective on November 30, 2026, reducing issued shares to 72,278,858.
title_en: Announcement regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 20, 2026, the board of directors of THE JAPAN WOOL TEXTILE CO., LTD. resolved to cancel 2,000,000 treasury shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation represents 2.69% of issued shares outstanding before the cancellation and is scheduled to become effective on November 30, 2026. Following this cancellation, the total number of issued shares will decrease from 74,278,858 to 72,278,858, while retained treasury stock will remain at 7,146,208 shares, representing 9.89% of issued shares after cancellation.
